happyPath.description: Baseline scenario: arranger is also the waste producer, single road carrier, mass-only quantity, EC list of wastes classification, no transit countries.
Two-leg journey (road then barge) with two carriers, mass and volume both supplied, one transit country.
Arranger is NOT the waste producer: wasteProducer and its declaration are populated, classified under Basel Annex IX.
Waste classified solely under Basel Annex IX (List B) rather than the EC list of wastes.
Waste classified under the OECD green list (a code not already covered by Basel Annex IX).
Interim, name-confidential recovery facility with a confidentiality explanation, plus a transit country.

expected.note: Joi schema validation error - actualDateOfShipment is required

errorCases.description: ecListOfWastes set to "99 99 99", not a real EWC code.

expected.note: findInvalidWasteCodes rejects an unrecognised EWC code before the record is persisted
Joi schema requires carriers to have at least one entry (.min(1))

errorCases.description: importerConsignee.contactDetails.email is not a valid email address.

expected.note: Joi schema requires contactDetails.email to pass .email()

errorCases.description: actualQuantity.tonnes and actualQuantity.metersCubed are both null - valid per the alpha's own JSON schema (quantitySchema has no .or() constraint), but DIWASS's own contract requires exactly one of mass or volume.

expected.note: Caught by the alpha's JSON schema since 12 October 2026: shipment.actualQuantity must give tonnes, metersCubed or both. Before that the API stored it and DIWASS answered NOTOK, MASS-VOLUME-NOT-FOUND (A1, confirmed live).

errorCases.description: Reuses annexVIIDocumentNo "AX-2026-HP-01" - run this AFTER hp-01 has already been submitted once.

expected.note: Mongo duplicate key (E11000) on annexVIIDocumentNo maps to Boom.conflict

errorCases.description: isAlsoWasteProducer is false but no wasteProducer is given (hp-03 with the producer removed).

expected.note: The alpha's JSON schema requires wasteProducer when the arranger is not the producer. Live DIWASS does not enforce this rule (err-soap-08, 12 October 2026), so DWT must.

errorCases.description: Structurally malformed XML - an unclosed <v1:illegalActivityIndication> element breaks the document tree.

expected.note: SOAP Fault 'Failed to copy a message', HTTP 500, as live DIWASS answers malformed XML (A5).

errorCases.description: Otherwise-valid request with an empty actualQuantity element (no MassMeasure or VolumeMeasure).

expected.note: Business rule, as live: HTTP 200, NOTOK, MASS-VOLUME-NOT-FOUND, annexVIIDocumentNo UNKNOWN.
Schema violation, as live: HTTP 500 SOAP Fault saying a carrier is expected.
Schema violation, as live: HTTP 500 SOAP Fault saying a wasteClassification is expected.

errorCases.description: exportCountry.countryID sent as the ISO alpha-2 code "GB" instead of the UN M49 numeric code the spec pack's own samples use (e.g. 826).

expected.note: Schema violation, as live: HTTP 500 SOAP Fault, 'GB' fails the three-digit CountryCodeType pattern (A2 resolved).

errorCases.description: CreateOperatorRequest reusing the EORI (GB123456789000) already registered for the seeded "arranger" operator.

expected.note: DuplicateOperatorError. Differs from live: an operator user creating a duplicate gets HTTP 500 'Some business rules are not met' with no reason, so the emulator keeps the clearer 409.

errorCases.description: consignee.OperatorInternalID set to 999999 - never registered via CreateOperatorRequest.

expected.note: As live: HTTP 200, NOTOK, CONSIGNEE-OPERATOR-IS-REQUIRED and OPERATOR-ID-NOT-FOUND (A3 resolved).

errorCases.description: shipmentArrangerIsAlsoProducerOrCollector is false, but no wasteProducer or declarationProducer block is supplied.

expected.note: Accepted, as live DIWASS accepts it: the producer rule is not enforced by DIWASS (A4 disproved), so DWT must enforce it.
